authorSummary:
Attempt013 is a Construction pass (realization_refactor) on 6937d30e8. I verified the basis first: read .claude/skills/stdo-work/SKILL.md and PRODUCT_BASIS.md, and stdo_abiogenesis.json selects STDO v3.0.2 (`stdo status --verify` passed, manifest f7f3f824…). I updated both HOW docs before touching code.

(a) instruction_assembly.ts now builds a current-binding section from the existing owners: exact invocation admission, Run binding, semantic-job root and the admitted root definition. It shows the Run, invocation, Program, root GraphFunction and digest, Public start, executing GraphFunction, and the declared recursion bound when exactly one recurse application matches. The predecessor is a separate field taken from sourceResultBasis. The section is in the envelope and its digest is in the manifest. If the binding can't be resolved, the assembly refuses with unknown_dependency.

(b) native_workspace_work.ts no longer forces W⊆R. The read-only, authority, binding and path guards are unchanged.

(c) native_work_effect.ts has one conservative impact relation: observed changed paths plus the part of W outside R, or all of W when the effect is unknown. Overlap is exact path or subtree. Both the Event Calculus axioms and the currentness gate in native_worksite_execution.ts use it, so affected present and absent facts are retired.

(d) registered-graph-selection.mjs now handles asset, next and declared start through ProductExecutionResolutionPort. It adds pendingExecutionUseRequest and constructInstalledPendingCall, which check that the pending root's authority equals the start's. The default-library same-Run and retained-A/B tests now use them, so their duplicate blocks are gone, and they gained binding assertions.

I edited 11 of the 13 granted paths; t288-instruction-assembly-owner and t287-native-assembly-retained-input needed no change. node --check passes on the 4 edited MJS files. readiness.json reports FILE_ONLY_READY with 9/9 hashes matched and no issues. I did not run tsc, build, generation or tests, and adopted nothing generated. Nothing was written outside the grant; notes.md and return.json are in scratch13 and tmp is empty.
